distribution: Mengla, Jinping, Yunnan, 480 m above sea level; Jinghong, 500 m above sea level.
soldier: Head of the soldier nearly quadrangular, widest at the antennal insertions, the posterior margin arcuate; dorsum of the head with a pale T-shaped stripe. Postclypeus arched, about half as long as wide; labrum broadly rounded in the anterior part, narrow in the posterior part. Antennae with 15 segments, segment 2 longer than segment 3. Pronotum very highly arched, the anterior margin concave in the middle in some individuals; abdomen swollen, oval. Total body length 4.43 to 4.86 mm.
worker: Head of the worker brownish yellow, antennae, thorax and abdomen pale yellow to white. The dorsum of the head, thorax and abdomen covered with sparse fine short hairs, the ventral surface of the abdomen with more numerous and longer hairs.
